entries.title: Psalms 148:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights!

entries.title: Psalms 148:2
segments: Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His hosts!

entries.title: Psalms 148:3
segments: Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all you stars of light!

entries.title: Psalms 148:4
segments: Praise Him, you heavens of heavens, And you waters above the heavens!

entries.title: Psalms 148:5
segments: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For He commanded and they were created.

entries.title: Psalms 148:6
segments: He also established them forever and ever; He made a decree which shall not pass away.

entries.title: Psalms 148:7
segments: ¶Praise the LORD from the earth, You great sea creatures and all the depths;

entries.title: Psalms 148:8
segments: Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;

entries.title: Psalms 148:9
segments: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

entries.title: Psalms 148:10
segments: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying fowl;

entries.title: Psalms 148:11
segments: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 148:12
segments: Both young men and maidens; Old men and children.

entries.title: Psalms 148:13
segments: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory [is] above the earth and heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 148:14
segments: And He has exalted the horn of His people, The praise of all His saints-Of the children of Israel, A people near to Him. Praise the LORD!
